audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Yone's E 'Spirit Rewind' throughout (focus.text, loading, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2], report[1], report[5]) and calls Fate Sealed a knockup in six places across both layers.
audit.why: His E is Soul Unbound — the content layer already uses the right name, so the two layers disagreed with each other. And Riot's R text is 'blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him' — a PULL, with no knockup flag on the ability. The knockup in his kit is Mortal Steel at 2 stacks. This matters: a player told to fear an R knockup will misread which spell to dodge, and Meditate is cancelled by the Q3 knockup, not by the ult.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound named everywhere; Fate Sealed described as a blink-behind pull; Mortal Steel at 2 stacks named as the actual knockup and as the thing that cancels Meditate.

edits.before: Yone's R (Fate Sealed) knockup is the only thing that can lock you down for a follow-up — bait it or Alpha Strike its wind-up to go untargetable, and respect his E (Spirit Rewind) as his escape when you commit your all-in.
edits.after: Yone's R (Fate Sealed) blinks behind you and PULLS you in — Alpha Strike its wind-up to go untargetable and it grabs nothing. His real knockup is Mortal Steel at 2 stacks, and Soul Unbound (E) is the 22s escape to wait out before you commit.

edits.after: FAVOURED (56.26% WR) — a tough but losable early phase that flips hard the moment Master Yi itemizes, because Yone's mobility can't escape an on-hit hyper-carry who goes untargetable through his only lockdown.
